observations: Existing generator consumes source-vocabulary draft logits, decodes proposals to text, and re-encodes them in target vocabulary for greedy verification.
Optional lookup maps provide shortcuts to retokenization; both archived maps have multiple source entries sharing destination IDs.
The inspected generator is a Transformers inference-mode path, not a differentiable AUF trainer or a native vLLM cross-family implementation.
limitations: Static map counts are not measurements of token equivalence, runtime mapping coverage, normalization, or cross-family correctness.
Per-source-position probabilities are not automatically per-target-position probabilities after variable-length retokenization.
No new vLLM/AUF cross-family feasibility result has been established.
next_gate: Validate a compatible proposal probability and label alignment contract before any cross-family fit or sweep.
authorized_fallback: If compatibility or correctness cannot be established without materially changing the method, retain shared-vocabulary Qwen3 claims and defer heterogeneous-vocabulary DFlash.
